tei:div.tei:p: "$ (603)༄༅// bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid yig bzhugs so/// /

(604)༄༅// rgyud sde rin po che thams cad kyi zab don ma lus pa'i don ston par byed pa/ rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub ces pa'i khrid yig /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bskyed par byed pa'i yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid dang*/ rje grub thob chen po'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// de la thog mar lus rtsa dag par byed pa sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan/ gnyis pa ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung rdo rje'i sgrub pa/ srog stsol dang 'dzin pa/ gsum pa yid thig le dag par byed pa thugs rdo rje'i sgrub pa chen po dang gsum mo// de yang yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su mun pa legs par bsgrubs nas/ log 'tsho spangs pa'i yo byad tshogs par byas te/ skyabs/ rjes dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ 'gro sems bskyed rnams sngon du 'gro ba tshar ba'i rjes la/ g.yas pa'i rtsa la srog babs pa'i dus su bsgom par bya ste/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rtsa yi bcud/ nam mkha'i mthongs su (605)gza' rnams brtan par bcings/ ces pa'i don nyams su len pa'i rim pa ni/ steng gi skyil krung gis steng gi rlung bcings/ 'og gi skyil krung gis 'og gi rlung bcings/ bar gyi skyil krung gis bar gyi rlung bcings te// dang po ni rdo rje skyil krung bya/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur bcangs la brla rtsa mnan/ mig gnyis rdo rje gtsug tor gyi lta stangs bya zhing dbang po'i sgo lnga khrim sgrim mo// dmigs pa gang yang mi 'dzin par sgom 'dod kyi rtog pa thams cad phyir bsnyil te/ tha na nyams myong dang rtags kyi 'dod pa tsam yang mi byed par blo brten gang la yang ma 'cha'/ blos gang du yang mi 'dzin par mi rtog pa'i ngang du ma yengs tsam du bzhag cing*/ sgo lnga bcud la bor bas/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung dang*/ rnam par rtog pa nang du bkag na/

rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skye zhing*/ du ba la sogs pa'i stong gzugs mthong bar 'gyur ro// de yang mun (606)par bsgom pa'i tshe/ dus gsum gyi spyos pa bcad nas/ bzo bcos gang yang med par mig mi 'dzum zhing mig 'bras mi 'gul bar had de 'jog pa yin/ skabs skabs su mun snang de nyid la mig gi dbang po dang rig pa khyab par bkod nas shes pa bzo med du 'jog /thun mtshams su yang*/ mdun gyi nam mkha' gang snang la mig gi dbang po dang shes pa khyab par bkod nas/ ma yengs pa'i ngos nas mi sgom par 'jog pa yin/ ma yengs la rtsol ba med pa'i gnad de la rig pa legs par chun na nyams myong btsan thabs su skye/ des ma zin na 'phral tung tung gis 'gyur drags kyi rtsol ba bskyed kyang sgom gyi sna sun pa'i rkyen du song dogs yod pas gnad zin pa gal che'o// gnyis pa/ de nas 'og skyil krung gis/ rgya mtsho'i steng du rtsa gsum yan lag bsdams/ ces pa'i lag len 'di/ bsam gtan gyis chos lnga dang ldan pas/ 'og gnyis thad kar bsdam nywa bzhi bsgrim rkang pa'i sor mo rnams bskum/ sgal tshigs dgye bar bya/ lte ba man chad cha cha nas bsgrims nas/ rnam snang gi lta stangs thur du blta zhing*/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jog pa ste/ de ltar bsgom pas steng gi skyon 'og gis sel la/ steng skyil krung bsgoms pas 'og gi skyon rnams sel lo// gsum pa/ de nas steng 'og gnyis gcig tu byed pa la/ bar skyil krung bsgom pa ni/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan pas/ de la mo cung zad dgye bar bya zhing*/ lte ba phyir bskyed de nan tan du bsgoms pas/ steng 'og gnyis ka'i gegs sel ba la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med do// (607)bzhi pa/ de nas nyi ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ nam mkha' rgya chen po mthong ba'i sar/ nyi ma la rgyab phyogs par byas nas lus gnad lta stangs dang*/ sems kyi 'jog sngar ltar byas nas bsgoms pas/

nyin mo'i rtags rnams mthor bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rtags kyi snang ba sna tshogs pa de thams cad rig pa gsal stong ngo bor ngo 'phrod dgos te/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad rang gi sems snang ba las logs su med cing*/ rtags snang ma 'gags par gsal ba de/ sems kyi mtshan nyid yin la/ de'i rang bzhin stong par gnas pas snang stong dbyer med pa'i ngo bo chu nang gi zla ba'am/ me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar du ngo sprad gsung so// grub pa'i tshad ni tshig gi mchog ster ba ste/ me dang gdon la sogs pa zhi bar gyur cig ces pas zhi ba la sogs pa'o// dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dbyer med du shes pas/ lha sku lngar shar ba ni bsam gtan gyi rtags bcu'o// yan lag ni/ shes rab dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ g.yo med bde ba ste bsam gtan gyi yan lag lnga'o// de la shes rab ces pa ni/ yod pa'i chos thams cad stong par mthong ba rnams la stong pa nyid kyi gzugs de nyid la sems rab tu 'jug cing blta ba'o// rtog pa yis ni sems kyi dngos po 'dzin pa'o// spyod pa ni de'i don nges pa ste/ 'dzin pa'i dngos po rtog pa'o// dga' ba ni stong pa nyid kyi gzugs la chags pa ste/ dngos po thams cad la sems gnas pa'o// g.yo med pa'i bde ba ni stong gzugs dang (608)sems lhan cig tu byed de/ dngos po thams cad la bde ba phun sum tshogs pa'o// so sor sdud kyi gzugs mthong ba la/ bsam gtan gyi gzugs la sems kyis kun nas mkhyud de brtan par byed pa yin no// yon tan ni mngon par shes pa lnga 'char pa la sogs pa'o// de ltar so sor sdud dang bsam gtan gyis sku rdo rje'i bsnyen pa song nas/ lnga pa// spyi don lnga pa ngag rlung dag par byed pa gsung rdo rje'i sgrub pa ni/ stan bde ba la lus gnad lta stangs dang ldan pas/ rang lhar bskyed/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/

rlung ro legs par phyung ste sgom pa ni/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rtsa ba'i rlung rnams kyang*// de dus sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas par 'gyur/ ces rlung nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ bar du gnas pa hūm̐/ phyir dbyung pa āḥ yi ge gsum rang bzhin rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya ba yin/ bgrang phreng spangs pa'i bzlas pa ci rigs pa cig byed pa yin// drug pa/ de'i rjes su rlung gi mal 'tshol ces pa/ dmigs pa med pas rlung lam du byed pa'i rlung sbyor rnam pa lnga sgom ste/ nam mkha'i rlung gi 'dzin stangs/ 'jug pa dang 'byung ba tshor rig med pa lta bur 'jam zhing ngal la cha snyoms pas yun ring du bzung*/ bdun pa/ de bzhin rlung gi rlung ngag la ring par bzung*/ brgyad pa/ me'i rlung drag la thung pa rbud rbud bzung la bsgom/ dgu pa/ chu'i rlung so bar cung zad bsdams pa'i bar nas bzhur la sir sgra dang bcas la bsgom/ bcu pa/ sa'i rlung nam mkha'i rlung la cung zad drag par tshor ma tshor tsam du dal bu yi bzung la bsgom/ (609)rlung sbyor de rnams kyi gnad 'thems na rlung so sor drod rtags dang nyams rtogs 'phral du skye/ rlung sbyor phyi ma rnams la gegs mi yong ba yin gsungs/ bcu gcig pa/ de nas 'og thur ser gyi rlung gis/ gdan dang 'byung ba rims brtsegs bsgom pa ni// nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa rnams kyi// thur du bsdams pas dkyil 'khor gsal bar blta// ces pas/ 'byung ba so so'i rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyi srog rlung bzung ste/ lte ba'i 'og tu phul bas thur sel bsdams par bya'o// dmigs pa ni/ e yig sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor sngon po gru gsum as mtshan pa/ shin tu dwangs pa blos 'khyud tshad bsgom/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pa'i rtags lus med pa lta bu'i stong nyams bzang po 'char ro// bcu gnyis pa/ chos 'byung de'i steng du laṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/

rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa yang zhing g.yo ba cig sgom/ zin rtags mgo zi ba dang g.ya' za ba la sogs pa 'byung*// bcu gsum pa/ rlung gi steng du raṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum reg bya shin tu tsha ba raṃ gyis mtshan pa bsgom/ zin rtags sngar las drod che ba dang lus tsha ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ bcu bzhi pa/ me'i steng du baṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar la zlum pa reg bya bsil ba bum pas mtshan pa bsgom/ rang gi 'og tu rlung*/ rang gi 'og tu me/ rang gi 'og tu chu zer ba'ang snang*/ (610)zin rtags grang ba dang 'dar ba la sogs pa 'byung*/ bco lnga pa/ chu'i steng du laṃ yig yongs su gyur ba las/ sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa reg bya shin tu lci ba rdo rje rgya gram bzhis mtshan pa bsgom/ rlung zin pa'i rtags shes pa lci ba dang*/ 'gro snying mi 'dod pa la sogs pa 'ong*/ 'di rnams sgom pa'i dus 'og rlung la gnad du bsnun pa'i rlung sbyor yin no// 'byung ba so so'i rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis 'byung ba rims brtsegs bsgom par bshad pa 'di/ rim pa rim par brtan bsgom pa'i lugs yin zhing*/ mgyogs chod du bsgom pa'i lugs 'byung ba rims brtsegs kyang lha gang bsgom pa'i rigs kyi rlung sbyor de kas bsgom pas chog pa yin gsung*/ bcu drug pa/ de yang 'byung ba rims brtsegs kyi steng du/ ye shes kyi gdan ljang khu zlum po'i dbyibs can dang*/ bcu bdun pa/ sgra gcan dang*/ bco brgyad pa/ nyi ma dang*/ bcu dgu pa/ zla ba dang*/ nyi shu pa/ dus me rnams kyi gdan tsho dbyibs zlum po// reg bya 'byung ba rims brtsegs dang mthun par bsgom mo// 'og thur sel gyi rlung zhes bya ba/ mo rlung zhes bya ste/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rlung sbyor ro// nyer gcig pa/ de nas steng srog rtsol gyi rlung sbyor sa bon yig 'bru bskyed pa ni/

sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i bdag nyid kyi// yig 'bru rgyu ba ā li kā li'i rlung*// ces pa/ srog rlung sa rlung gi 'dzin pa stongs kyis ā li kā li gser btso ma'i mdog can/ me tog gi phreng ba lta bu se nar nar byung gdan du me'i steng du babs pas se ham me ba la dmigs pa gtad/ (611)de la nan tan du sgom zhing mi thub par gtong ba'i dus su/ rlung phyir dbyung ba dang mnyam du yig 'bru rnams kyang gyen la se na ra ra song bar bsgom// nyer gnyis pa/ yang chu rlung gi 'dzin stang kyis ā li kā li mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu skya na ra ra byung*/ zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du dkar hram me ba la dmig pa gtad/ rlung phyir dbyung ba'i dus su dkar na ra ra song bar bsam mo// nyer gsum pa/ yang me rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis ā li kā li byi ru'i mdog lta bu dmar na ra ra byung nas nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du dmar hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad nas/ phyir dbyung pa yang dmar na ra ra song bar bsam mo// nyer bzhi pa/ yang rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis ā li kā li nag po nag na ra ra byung ba sgra gcan gyi steng du nag hril ba la dmigs pa gtad/ phyir dbyung ba yang nag na ra ra song bar bsam mo// nyer lnga pa/ nam mkha'i rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyis ā li kā li bai ḍūr+ya'i mdog lta bu sngo na ra ra byung ba ye shes kyi gdan gyi steng du sngo hram me ba la dmigs pa gtad/ phyir dbyung ba yang sngo na ra ra song bar bsam mo// 'byung ba so so'i rlung gi 'dzin rtags thur sel gyi skabs dang 'dra'o// de thams cad kyi thun mgo la lta stangs bsgom/ de nas dmigs med kyi rlung bsgom/ de nas srog rtsol gyi rlung bsgom pa yin gsung*/ de ni steng srog rtsol gyi rlung zhes bya/ pho rlung zhes bya ste steng nas 'jug pa yin no// nyer drug pa/ de dag brtan pa dang bar rlung la bsten nas phyag mtshan bskyed pa ni// rdo rje ral gri rin chen pad+ma dang*// (612)'khor lo rnams ni rim bzhin gsal bar blta// steng 'og bar du bsdams pas thob par 'gyur/

ces pa dang*/ rang rang gi rlung gi 'dzin stangs kyi steng du rlung bzung 'og rlung 'then/ bar rlung bzung nas steng 'og gnyis cung zad glod de/ gdan la gnas pa'i sa bon rnams yongs su gyur pa las rim pa bzhin hri sngon po dang*// nyer bdun pa/ ral gri nag po dang*// nyer brgyad pa/ rin po che dmar po dang*// nyer dgu pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po dang*// sum cu pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ser po rnams bsgom par bya'o// de rnams bar rlung gi sbyor bas te/ rlung sems steng 'og bar gsum dang yan lag gang du'ang 'drongs pa la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med pa yod do// de yan chad kyis steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung gi gnad bstan nas// so gcig pa/ 'dzin pa la kha sbyor gyi rlung gis lha sku slong ba'i rnal 'byor gsungs/ snod bcud tha mal 'dzin pa rab spangs te// gdan dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gsal ba las// rigs las skyes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku// gdan dang long bu ske rags tshangs skud dang*// phyag dang zhal dang spyan dang skra mtshams dang*// rgyan dang cha lugs ma lus rab rdzogs par// gtsug tor bar du rim bzhin gsal bar blta// ces te/ snod bcud ni brtan g.yo'i dngos po thams cad rdul phra rab kyi rdzas dang bral zhing*/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pas/ tha mal du 'dzin pa dang bral bas te mngon du byed pa'i thabs/ zung 'jug gi lha (613)sku bsgom pas te/ sngar gyi sa bon dang phyag mtshan re re'i skabs su/ lha sku rigs dang mthun pa re re slong ba yin/ rims kyi slong ba la/ rang rang gi steng 'og bar gsum 'dzin stangs kyi 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang*/ gdan sa bon/ phyag mtshan rnams bsgom nas/ kha sbyor gyi lha sku bskyed pa yin la/ de yang nam mkha'i khams nas bskyed/ rdo rje sngon po yongs su gyur pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'am bde mchog la sogs pa'i lha yab yum krongs bskyed la rim pas gsal gdab pa ni/

'og gi rlung sbyor cung zhig gsal bas/ lta stangs smad la/ bcom ldan 'das bde mchog la rim pa'i gnad dang*/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang*/ yab sku mdog sngon po// yum dmar po// de gnyis ka'i long bu dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/ sku smad dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyi brlab pa dang*/ stag lpags dang*/ bar rlung bsal bas/ rked pa dang*/ ske rags dang*/ sku stong dang*/ tshangs skud dang*/ mgul brgyan dang*/ phyag dang*/ phyag mtshan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ dpung rgyan dang*/ steng rlung bsal/ zhal dang*/ shangs dang*/ spyan dang*/ gtsug tor dang*/ nor bu dang*/ snyan dang*/ snyan cha dang*/ thod phran dang*/ ral pa'i thor cog dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ yum gyi skra grol ba dang*/ dar dpyangs la sogs pa rnams rim par gsal la ma 'dres par gsal gdab/ de yang spyi mi gsal na spyi (614)gsal gdab/ bye brag mi gsal na bye brag gsal gdab ste/ ji srid brtan pa ma thob kyi bar du bsgom pa'o// so gnyis pa/ gtsug tor nas bzung gdan la de bzhin no// ces pa yang gtsug tor nas bzung gdan gyi bar du de rnams yas rims gyis gsal 'debs pa'o// so gsum pa/ de bzhin du ral gri yongs su gyur pa las rlung khams pa// so bzhi pa/ rin po che las me khams pa// so lnga pa/ 'khor lo las sa khams pa bskyed pa yin no// de rnams kyis kha sbyor gyi rlung zhes bya/ gsang ba ye shes kyi rlung zhes bya/ bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor ro// so drug pa/ de la lha yab rnams ni bcu drug gi na tshod dang*/ yum rnams ni bcu gnyis kyi na tshod tsam bsgoms pas mchog ster bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rlung lam du slongs shing bskyed rim brtan pa'i dus su/ snang ba thams cad snang stong dbyer med par bar snang gi 'ja' tshon nam/ sgyu ma lta bu snang la rang bzhin med par ngo sprad gsungs so// so bdun pa/ de nas drod dang bde ba'i bogs dbyung bar 'dod na/

dang po lha me khams pa gsal ba'i lte ba nas song bzhi'i 'og tu nyi ma'i gdan la pad+ma'am/ rin po che kha dog dmar zhing gsal ba'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ reg bya shin tu tsha ba la dmigs nas me rlung btsan thabs su 'dzin pa yin// so brgyad pa/ bde ba la bde chen 'khor lo'i haṃ la byang chub sems kyi rgyun thigs pa 'bab pa lta bur ā li kā li'i rnam pa lte ba'i 'og tu babs pas/ lus thams cad bde bas gang bar bsgoms/ 'di'i skabs su rtsa'i gtso mo (615)gsal btab kyang yod gsungs so// so dgu pa/ srog rtsol gyi sgo nas bgrang phreng spangs pa'i bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ phrin las chen po bsgrub la/ do li'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags kyi phreng ba yab kyi sa bon las thon dbu ma'i lam brgyud yum gyi bha gar babs/ sku'i byin rlabs brgyud/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim pa ni bde stong bskyed pa'i bzlas pa yin gsungs// bzhi bcu pa/ de dag la sa bon de nyid gsum gyi bar bcug pa thugs rdo rje'i bzlas pa// zhe gcig pa/ ming de nyid gsum gyi bar du bcug pa gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa// zhe gnyis pa/ sku'i bstod pa de nyid gsum gyi bar du bcug pa sku rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste/ de la yang g.yon nas de bzhin du rgyu ba sku rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ g.yas nas rgyu ba gsung rdo rje'i bzlas pa/ dbus nas rgyu ba thugs rdo rje'i bzlas pa ste/ rlung gang rgyu bltas la de dang de'i bzlas pa bya'o// zhe gsum pa/ de la yang nang brtsegs su byed na/ chu rlung bzhi sbyor zhi ba'i las// ces gsungs pa/ lha chu khams pa bskyed/ chu rlung dbu mar bcug /oṃ ma ma ki ri ki ri che ge mo shān+ting ku ru na maḥ zhes yid kyis rlung bzung la bzlas pas/ nad la sogs pa zhi ba'i las 'grub bo// sa rlung bzhi sbyor rgyas pa'i las/ lha sa khams pa bskyed/ sa rlung dbu mar bcug /oṃ lo tsa na ba su dhe che ge mo puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes pa tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas par byed do// me rlung bzhi sbyor dbang gi las// ces pas lha me khams pa bskyed/ me rlung dbu mar bcug /oṃ paṇa ḍa ra bā su ni ba ra te che ge mo bau ṣaṭa= ces pas rgyal (616)po la sogs pa dbang du byed do// rlung rlung bzhi sbyor drag po'i las/ ces pas/ lha rlung khams pa bskyed/ rlung gi rlung dbu mar bcug /oṃ tā re tut+tā re che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ ces pas/ bsgral ba'i zhing rnams bsad pa'i las 'grub bo// gzhan yang dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmongs pa dang*/ dug zhi ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ tshad rims kyis gdab pa dang*/ phur bus gdab ste las chen po bcu gnyis 'grub pa yin no// yang lha nam mkha' khams pa bskyed/ nam mkha'i rlung dbu mar bcug /gang sgrub byed pa de mi snang bar bsgoms pas mi snang bar 'gyur ro// yang rlung bsnyen par bgrang pa ces pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lte bar las dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyag mtshan gdan dang bcas pa bskyed la/ las sgrub pa'i sngags kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa bsgrub la/ sa bon dang ming dang bstod pa gsum/ de nyid gsum gyi bar du bcug pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi bsnyen par 'gyur ba ni gong bzhin no// de yang rang rang gi 'dzin stangs kyis/ rlung yig 'bru'i rnam par bcug nas phyag mtshan la 'khor ba la rig pa 'dzin pa ste/ de dang mnyam du gsus pa la bskor ba yin/ de yang lus byin po mi 'gul bar gsus pa g.yas g.yon du re mos su bskor ba ro rkyang gnyis su ā li kā li'i rnam par sna bug nas zhugs ste/ sum mdor slebs pa dang dbu ma'i nang du yar song ste/ 'og tu phyag mtshan du gyur/ de la sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs pa ni gsang ba ye shes kyi 'khor lugs so// phyogs gcig tu dus rtag tu bskor na yon po'i gegs yong gsungs/ srog rtsol la 'gog pa'i bzlas pa ces pa la/

srog ni gyen rgyu yin la/ rtsol ba ni khrid kyi lag len gyi rlung lam du byed pa'o// de ltar srog rtsol gyis (617)nyi zla'i 'gro 'ong 'gags pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rlung du 'gyur zhing*/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas srog rlung thig le'i nang du tshud nas/ rlung sems haṃ gi thig ler 'dzin/ ces pa ni/ srog rtsol gyi 'bras bu yin gsungs/ man ngag gdams pa'i gnad 'di zhu ba la// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i sbyor ba ma zhugs shing*// chos dang bla ma tshur bzhin bkur byas la// nyams myong rtogs pa'i drod dang ldan par shog /bla mar gsang zhing gdams pa'i drod nyul ba'i// kha bsags g.yo rgyus gdams pa len 'dod la// dmar khrid lag len byin na dam tshig nyams// snod ldan snod min shin tu brtag pa gces// snying nas tshe 'di spangs nas nyams len zhing*// chos 'di'i skal bar ldan pa'i rnal 'byor bas// byung na g.yo rgyu med pas sbyin par bya// de lta min na rgyal ba'i bka' dang 'gal// chos 'di rang gi sor sdud lo gcig 'dres med du bsgom mi nus pa'i mi la gdams pa 'di sbyin du med do// bla ma dang chos bdag mnyes par mi byed pa la gdams pa 'di sbyin du med do// gser gyi me tog thad kar mi 'bul ba la gdams pa 'di sbyin du med do// dam bca' 'di rnams dang 'gal ba'i snod min rnams la gdams pa 'di bstan pa byung na/ 'di'i snying khrag chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gtor bar rigs so// rje grub thob chen po'i gsung*/ phyag len bzhin du rgyal khams pa zla ba seng ges zin bris su btab pa'i khrig yig re zhig rdzogs so// maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu/ shu bhaṃ/// /
